statements.t: ​ “Entering fiscal 2027, we expect that the strong momentum from 2026 will continue as we are well positioned to keep capitalizing on growth drivers and deliver value for our shareholders.
With strong orders across our businesses, we expect first quarter sales to be up mid-teens and to deliver more than 20 percent EPS growth year over year.
For the full fiscal year, we expect to deliver organic sales growth that is similar to our strong performance in fiscal 2026.”
For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, the company expects sales of approximately $5.35 billion, up 15% on a reported and organic basis year over year.

statements.t: For fiscal 2026, we expect total restructuring charges to be approximately $100 million and total cash spend, which will be funded with cash from operations, to be approximately $110 million.

Our ability to fund our future capital needs will be affected by our ongoing ability to generate cash from operations and may be affected by our access to capital markets, money markets, or other sources of funding, as well as the capacity and terms of our financing arrangements.

We intend to fund the anticipated acquisition of Astrodyne TDI with a combination of available cash and the issuance of commercial paper and, if necessary, borrowing under our existing credit facility and/or new debt financing.
We will continue to monitor financial markets and respond as necessary to changing conditions.
We believe that we have sufficient financial resources and liquidity which will enable us to meet our ongoing working capital and other cash flow needs.
We expect fiscal 2026 capital spending levels to be approximately 6% of net sales.
